title: Great Nonstick Finish, But NOT Dishwasher Safe; Pans Rust
text:
Great Nonstick Finish, But NOT Dishwasher Safe; Pans Rust. These CASAWARE 9 x 6 x 0.75-INCH TOASTER OVEN BAKING PANS (Silver Granite) are the perfect size for my excellent [[ASIN:B003Z34OME Oster Toaster Oven]], and they have a wonderful nonstick ceramic finish. Cooked food spills slide right off the sheets under running water.

However, the pans are NOT dishwasher safe. I put mine through the dishwasher anyway, expecting some damage to the nonstick finish over time. To my surprise, the finish holds up well, but the pans themselves rust. Water gets into the rolled edges of the pans, and then they drip rusty water onto my clean dishes as I take them out of the dishwasher.

The pans will rust even if you handwash them, as recommended by the manufacturer. For me, the pans are a total loss--and a surprising loss, given how much these pans cost compared to other toaster oven pans.
